baseUrl.description: The subscribed StUF consumer's inbound endpoint URL

mode.description: `token` (default, pre-production fallback) sends a Bearer Authorization header from `encryptedToken`. `mtls` (the expected production mode for a real StUF/PKIoverheid-secured consumer) dispatches over a real mutual-TLS connection using `mtls.*`. `wsse` sends no Authorization header: the ZDS case client puts a WS-Security UsernameToken from `wsse.*` in the envelope.

wsse.description: Optional WS-Security UsernameToken for StUF-ZDS case messages, used by the ZDS case client in any mode. The password is encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto.

requireNonce.description: Inbound only (provider requests and confirmations): refuse a UsernameToken that carries no Nonce and Created. A token that does carry them is always checked: Created within five minutes of now, and a Nonce not seen before.

encryptedToken.description: Required when `mode=token`. The StUF consumer API token, encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto — never store the raw token.

scheme.description: Authorization header scheme, used only when `mode=token`.

mtls.description: Required when `mode=mtls`. Client certificate material, each field individually encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto.

encryptedCaBundle.description: Optional PEM CA bundle to verify the peer against.

organisatie.description: This bridge's own organisatie code (stuurgegevens.zender default).
